title: notNotes Web as a reference consumer, not Builder core
summary: The notNotes Web work exercises a modern semantic control catalogue and live Wire projection without moving NotNotes business truth into JavaScript or Builder core. It is a compatibility/reference fixture for documents, approvals, reports, relationships, temporal context, instrumentation evidence and dynamic intentions.
invariants: NotNotes application truth remains in ooRexx/application objects.
Browser JS emits/returns semantic Wire actions rather than implementing NotNotes business rules.
Time/date presentation must use authoritative temporal semantics; the browser must not guess ambiguous offsets.
Instrumentation state is evidence/health context and must not become business authority.
Intention discovery is dynamic; provider confidence, resolved slots and READY state must be refreshed rather than permanently cached.
The notNotes fixture must not make NotNotes vocabulary mandatory for generic Builder releases.

provenance.claim: Reference-consumer development evidence for modern Web projection and v0.4 semantic compatibility.
Development/recovery evidence; does not supersede the accepted v0.11 executable baseline.
